# Timeout budget: duration distribution before/after the fix

Budget = 100ms per pipeline. All times in ms, measured on an injected deterministic clock.

## Per-structure elapsed time (deterministic scenarios)

| structure | legacy (buggy) | fixed | budget |
|---|---|---|---|
| single step 40ms | 40ms | 40ms | 100ms |
| serial 3 x 50ms | 150ms **OVER** | 100ms | 100ms |
| retry 3 x 60ms (flaky) | 180ms **OVER** | 100ms | 100ms |
| nested retry 3x3 x 40ms | 360ms **OVER** | 100ms | 100ms |
| parallel 90ms + 70ms | 90ms | 90ms | 100ms |
| serial 40ms + parallel 2 x 90ms | 130ms **OVER** | 100ms | 100ms |
| repro pipeline (fetch+retry+fanout) | 350ms **OVER** | 100ms | 100ms |

## Randomized pipelines (2000 runs, seed=20260928)

| engine | runs | budget | min | p50 | p95 | max | mean | over budget |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| legacy (buggy) | 2000 | 100 | 10 | 95 | 261 | 795 | 101.5 | 457 (22.9%) |
| fixed | 2000 | 100 | 10 | 95 | 100 | 100 | 77.6 | 0 (0.0%) |

Fixed engine: worst-case elapsed = 100ms <= 100ms budget (upper bound holds for all 2000 runs).
Legacy engine: worst-case elapsed = 795ms (8.0x the budget).
